title: Property
learning_outcomes: Explain property cash flow in the context of property.
Compare and distinguish leverage in the context of property.
Apply vacancy and rate shocks in the context of property.
Evaluate and justify decisions about due diligence in the context of property.

lessons.title: Property cash flow
lessons.outcome: Explain property cash flow in the context of property.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving property cash flow; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to property sensitivity model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain property cash flow from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of property cash flow; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Leverage
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish leverage in the context of property.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving leverage; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to property sensitivity model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain leverage from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of leverage; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Vacancy and rate shocks
lessons.outcome: Apply vacancy and rate shocks in the context of property.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving vacancy and rate shocks; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to property sensitivity model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain vacancy and rate shocks from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of vacancy and rate shocks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Due diligence
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about due diligence in the context of property.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving due diligence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to property sensitivity model.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain due diligence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of due diligence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of property cash flow; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of leverage; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of vacancy and rate shocks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of due diligence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
